name: In The Sky - Rokid Radar
summary: Track nearby aircraft live on your Rokid Glasses.
description: Turn your Rokid Glasses into a live aircraft radar. The Android companion uses GPS and OpenSky data to show nearby aircraft, range, bearing, altitude, speed, track, callsign, and category in a lightweight glasses HUD. Configure a 1-200 mile range, aircraft-entry alerts, automatic HUD popups, and compass-oriented tracking from the phone.
author: robhowden-sudo

releases.notes:
First hardware-tested release of In The Sky — Rokid Radar.

Highlights:
- Phone-controlled Hi Rokid/CXR radar sessions
- OpenSky OAuth live aircraft data
- 1–200 mile range, range markers and alert zone
- Aircraft-entry sonar and optional 10-second alert HUD
- Selectable contacts and aircraft-category symbols
- Correct altitude handling and live/stale status
- Smooth phone-compass heading-up mode with -90° default offset
- Screen-off phone background operation
- Proven clear glasses renderer with no map/background layer

Install the phone APK on Android and the glasses APK on Rokid. Launch the HUD from the phone app through Hi Rokid.
